name: Chez Noir
address: 5th Ave. btw. Dolores and San Carlos Sts., Carmel-by-the-Sea, 93921
dinnerNote: Prix fixe menu, plus 20% service charge

menus.name: Prix fixe menu
menus.note: Changes daily; vegetarian options, but no vegan menu; special-event nights may be priced differently (see OpenTable); a 20% service charge and tax are added

bookingOpens: Online on OpenTable, for parties of up to six. Each month's tables are released on the 1st of the month before (all of November on 1 October). No deposit is taken.
cancellation: Cancelling, or cutting the party size, less than 48 hours before costs $165 a person. Cancel through the link in the confirmation email. Tables are held for 15 minutes.
waitlist: A waiting list runs on OpenTable, which emails you if a table comes free for your date and party size.
groups: No bookings for more than six, and a group can't be split across tables. Larger parties can ask about patio or whole-restaurant buyouts by email (info@cheznoircarmel.com).
children: Designed for adults and not well suited to young children: no children's menu, high chairs or room for prams. Children and babies who come must be counted in the booking.
byob: Corkage is $65 per 750ml bottle, two bottles or one magnum per table at most; not at the bar or for à la carte dining.
